Performance & game skills
How statuses work
Due means a scheduled direct-recall fact is ready for review, even if that challenge is currently switched off. Games add weighted mastery evidence without changing the spaced-review clock. Weak and Strong use both direct recall and gameplay evidence; Mastered still requires sustained clean retrieval over time.
